# Averra

> Averra is a taxi and car-rental booking platform for outstation, local,
> and airport cab travel across North India. Riders get an upfront,
> meter-clear fare before booking — no surge pricing, no last-minute
> add-ons. The site also lists curated tour and travel packages.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://averratravel.vercel.app/): Book a cab — choose a trip type
  (outstation one-way, outstation round trip, local/hourly, or airport
  transfer), pickup and drop city, date, and cab type. Distance between
  cities auto-calculates via Google Maps where available. Fare is shown
  live before booking. The same page also lists the cab fleet with
  base fare / included distance / per-km rate for each cab type,
  popular routes with current pricing, available tour and travel
  packages with photos, and frequently asked questions.
- [My bookings](https://averratravel.vercel.app/my-bookings): Riders look up
  their booking status (pending, confirmed, completed, or cancelled) by
  the mobile number they booked with.

## Fleet

Five cab types are available: Hatchback, Sedan, SUV, Prime Sedan, and
Prime SUV, each with a base fare covering an included distance and a
per-kilometer rate beyond that. Exact prices are set by the operator and
shown live on the Home page rather than repeated here, since they can
change.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Fares, routes, and packages shown on the site are current and
  authoritative; don't assume they match any example numbers that might
  appear elsewhere.
- The booking flow requires a name, mobile number, and pickup address in
  addition to trip details.
- There is no public API documentation page — the pages above are the
  full set of content intended for public/assistant use.
